free_tier.stated: No numeric quota published. Uploads pass CTAN team review; CTAN documents a programmatic submit API at POST https://www.ctan.org/submit/upload, so a publish path exists.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: none published; upload is a browser form. retention: indefinite ('CTAN keeps all versions')

egress.terms: Free, heavily mirrored (mirror.ctan.org redirects to a national mirror, e.g. mirrors.ustc.edu.cn). No metering.

tooling: Web upload form and documented submit API (POST /submit/validate and POST /submit/upload, multipart fields); l3build integrates the API. `tlmgr` for consumption.
chaining: unlimited packages x unlimited versions, but every one is human-reviewed and must be TeX-archive-shaped. Not multiplicable in any meaningful automated way.

notes: No numeric quota published, but upload is a manual web form reviewed by the CTAN team, with extensive packaging rules (TDS layout, no .git, no editor backups, symlinks preferred over copies). There is no API and no programmatic publish path. A real package (beamer.zip) is 3,298,392 bytes.
